name: omnibridge/doctrine
description: The storage glue of omnibase sites, framework-free: Doctrine reading the structure described outside of it (omnisense/omnibridge's Omnibridge\Schema), the naming strategy that turns their entities into their tables, the UTC date types, and an entity manager built with them, for any framework reading the same database; and omnibase's persistence on Doctrine (Omnibridge\Doctrine\Omnibase\: its repositories, finder compiler, mapping, DBAL types, walkers, filters and listeners), which omnisense/omnibase requires.

suggest.omnisense/omnibase: Omnibridge\Doctrine\Omnibase\: omnibase's persistence on Doctrine, moved from the core (its former Base\ names aliased by the core); loaded only with the core, which requires this package
